answer: Anchor each agent identity to a bonded stake held in a shared vault: before an agent can trade, it locks collateral that only its verified kernel can release after a cooling period. Creating a thousand fake identities then means funding a thousand vaults, so a Sybil flood costs real capital per identity instead of being free. Honest agents keep their stake and earn fees, while detected fakes forfeit theirs, turning identity forgery from a cheap trick into an expensive losing bet.
